explanation.fa: I have been waking up ... lately یعنی این اواخر بارها بیدار می‌شوم. این یک بار بیدارشدنِ تمام‌شده نیست؛ اخیراً تکرار می‌شود. فعلاً have been waking up را با این معنی و lately را با معنی «این اواخر» یاد بگیر.
explanation.en: I have been waking up ... lately describes repeated waking during a recent period, not one completed awakening. Learn have been waking up as a useful recent-problem pattern and lately as recently.

example.text: I have been waking up in the middle of the night lately.

translation.fa: این اواخر نیمه‌شب از خواب بیدار می‌شوم.
translation.en: I have been waking up in the middle of the night lately.

takeaway.fa: ساخت بلند را به یک معنی کاربردی وصل کن: اخیراً مدام بیدار می‌شوم.
takeaway.en: Connect the longer pattern to one useful meaning: I keep waking recently.

rows.text: in the middle of the night lately
at + clock time + part of day

explanation.fa: Is something worrying you? دربارهٔ نگرانی فعلی است. fall asleep یعنی به خواب رفتن؛ این عبارت را جداجدا به «افتادن» ترجمه نکن. cannot fall asleep again یعنی دوباره خوابم نمی‌برد.
explanation.en: Is something worrying you? asks about a current source of anxiety. Fall asleep means begin sleeping, not physically fall. Cannot fall asleep again describes the difficulty of returning to sleep.

example.text: I wake up at three in the morning and cannot fall asleep again.

translation.fa: ساعت سه صبح بیدار می‌شوم و دیگر خوابم نمی‌برد.
translation.en: I wake up at three in the morning and cannot fall asleep again.

takeaway.fa: fall asleep یک عبارت کامل برای به‌خواب‌رفتن است.
takeaway.en: Learn fall asleep as a complete expression.

title.en: Trying a method and replying briefly

explanation.fa: Have you tried listening ...? می‌پرسد این روش را امتحان کرده‌ای؟ پس از tried در این معنی listening می‌آید. I have یعنی بله، امتحان کرده‌ام و بخش طولانی تکرار نمی‌شود. listening to music هم to می‌خواهد.
explanation.en: Have you tried listening ...? asks whether a method has been tested, with listening after tried. I have confirms the attempt without repeating it. Keep to in listening to music.

example.text: Have you tried listening to calm music before you sleep?

translation.fa: امتحان کرده‌ای پیش از خواب موسیقی آرام گوش بدهی؟
translation.en: Have you tried listening to calm music before you sleep?

takeaway.fa: I have را از حرف قبل کامل کن: have tried listening.
takeaway.en: Complete I have from the earlier words: have tried listening.

explanation.fa: Perhaps you should write ... توصیه‌ای نرم است. write your tasks down یعنی کارها را یادداشت کن. cut down on coffee یعنی مصرف قهوه را کم کن، نه اینکه آن را قطعاً کامل کنار بگذار. Both در پاسخ بعد به همین دو تغییر اشاره دارد.
explanation.en: Perhaps you should write ... softens the advice. Write your tasks down means record them. Cut down on coffee means reduce it, not necessarily stop completely. Both in the next turn refers to these two changes.

example.text: That is a good idea, and I will also cut down on coffee in the afternoon.

translation.en: That is a good idea, and I will also cut down on coffee in the afternoon.

takeaway.en: Both refers to writing tasks and reducing coffee.

title.en: Purpose and an offer of support

explanation.fa: so your mind can rest هدف نوشتن کارهاست. give it a few days یعنی چند روز فرصت بده. I hope it works امید به نتیجه است؛ حرف‌های شخصیت‌ها تضمین پزشکی نیستند. if you need to talk شرط پیشنهاد حمایت را می‌گوید.
explanation.en: So your mind can rest gives the purpose of writing. Give it a few days asks for a short trial period. I hope it works expresses hope; the characters’ predictions are not medical guarantees. If you need to talk sets the condition for an offer of support.
